docs.title: catagg
docs.text:
Catastrophe loss aggregation, from event loss tables to net exceedance probability curves.

Pre-release

v0.1.0 is under development. The public API described in the README is the specification being built against, not yet the shipped surface.

docs.title: Install
docs.text:
pip install catagg

Python 3.11+. Runtime dependencies are numpy, pandas, pyarrow and scipy.

All notable changes to this project are documented here.

The format follows Keep a Changelog, and this project adheres to Semantic Versioning.

docs.title: Added
docs.text:
• Repository scaffolding generated from the shared template: hatchling build with src layout, ruff and mypy configuration, pytest setup, GitHub Actions CI (lint, type-check, five-way test matrix, docs build, distribution build), MkDocs Material documentation site, MIT licence, issue and pull request templates.
  • Empty subpackages fixing the module layout: io, frequency, severity, dependence, simulate, financial, metrics.
  • Packaging tests: version/metadata drift and py.typed installation.
